summary.text: Eerie fire snake gall is the gallbladder of an eerie fire dragon python, a valuable loot piece sold through treasure yellow heaven.

claims.text: After Fang Yuan kills an eerie fire dragon python while testing an improved killer move, he collects the mutated beast king’s body parts. Python blood feeds blood path Gu worms, and skin and tendons would stir the mortal market, while the eerie fire snake gall is extremely valuable and can be sold in treasure yellow heaven.

All parts of an eerie fire dragon python have value: blood for blood path Gu, and skin, tendons, and other parts as top-class refinement materials. The eerie fire dragon python’s gallbladder is extremely precious and has a market in treasure yellow heaven. Raising a large group of the living pythons would yield a continuous supply of those gallbladders for sale there.
